description: This file contains the implementation of the 'PersistentStreamProducer' class, which manages asynchronous message production in Orleans streaming framework, interfacing with a queue adapter and supporting stream operations like batching, error handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: PersistentStreamProducer<T>
classes.description: A class responsible for producing messages to a persistent stream in Orleans, supporting asynchronous operations, batching, and error handling.

methods.name: PersistentStreamProducer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the producer with stream, provider utilities, queue adapter, and copier; logs creation.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a single item to the stream with a sequence token.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of items to the stream with a sequence token.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for handling stream completion; not yet implemented.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for handling stream errors; not yet implemented.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations; currently a no-op.

methods.name: LogCreatedPersistentStreamProducer
methods.description: A partial method for logging the creation of a producer instance with specific stream info.
